preconditions.description: The number of rooms n must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= v <= 1000000 for x, y, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid room indices and have a valid time value.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= 100000000000 for l in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query value l must be between 1 and 100,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and result >= 0 for result in output)
postconditions.description: Each result in the output must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(result <= n for result in output)
postconditions.description: Each result must not exceed the number of rooms n.
